title: KDU Global Expands Partnerships Across Asia & Europe
highlight: New exchange pathways, dual-degree options, and joint programs for international student success.
highlightKo: 교류·복수학위·공동 프로그램으로 국제 학생 성과를 지원합니다.
excerpt: KDU Global continues to expand international partnerships to create stronger mobility and academic collaboration for global students.
content: KDU Global has announced new partnerships across Asia and Europe to strengthen international student mobility and academic collaboration.
These partnerships expand exchange pathways and support joint learning experiences aligned with global industry needs.
Students benefit from broader academic options, stronger international networks, and clearer global career outcomes.

title: New AI Innovation Lab Opens at KDU Global
titleKo: KDU Global AI 혁신 랩 오픈
highlight: A production-ready environment for ML prototyping, data engineering, and industry collaboration.
highlightKo: ML 프로토타입, 데이터 엔지니어링, 산학 협력을 위한 실무 환경.
excerpt: The AI Innovation Lab provides a modern learning and research environment designed for practical, career-ready outcomes.
content: The new AI Innovation Lab supports hands-on projects across machine learning, data engineering, and applied research.
The space is designed to help students build portfolio-grade work and collaborate with industry-style workflows.
KDU Global continues to invest in modern learning environments to support international student success.

title: Scholarships 2026: Merit-Based Awards for Global Students
highlight: Multiple scholarship tracks, streamlined review, and early decision benefits for international applicants.
highlightKo: 다양한 장학 트랙, 간소화된 심사, 조기 지원 혜택.
excerpt: Scholarships for 2026 are available for eligible global students with strong academic performance and leadership potential.
content: KDU Global scholarships for 2026 support international applicants through a range of merit-based tracks.
Applicants are encouraged to prepare a strong academic profile and submit clear supporting documents early.
Admissions advisors are available to guide students through eligibility and application timelines.
